scope: The Mosque of the Three Doors in the Kairouan medina with its masonry prayer hall, carved western façade and northwest minaret, as documented by the public-domain photograph uploaded in May 2007.

references.filename: Façade of the Mosque of the Three Gates.jpg

originalReview.notes: The warm ashlar west wall shows three recessed horseshoe portals and columns, four carved frieze bands and a corbelled cornice. The left minaret has a dark patterned tile frame, coupled arches, merlons and a small roofed cap.

quallaSearch.notes: The exact Qualla original matches the native Commons upload. The earliest revision was authored by the recorded uploader and explicitly applies PD-self. The capture date is unrecorded and the image was uploaded on 7 May 2007. The separately credited 1950 reproduction was outside the modeling reference set.
